Monetary Policy Summary

Bank of England Monetary Policy Summary, 20 August 2026

Inflation outlook

CPI inflation has fallen sharply from its peak. CPI inflation is projected to average 2.0 per cent in 2027. Inflation expectations remain anchored.

The economic outlook

GDP growth is expected to be 1.5 per cent in 2027. Domestic demand remains resilient.

Labour market

Wage growth is projected to be 3.2 per cent in 2026. Unemployment remains low.

Risks to the outlook

The risks around the inflation outlook are broadly balanced. There remains uncertainty surrounding global activity.

Forward guidance

The Committee will keep under review the future path of monetary policy. Policy will be set accordingly.
